input_policy: Completed hash-verified revision evidence, analysis summaries/CSVs, and audited optimization-summary CSV only; no raw result, per-fit, or prediction file read.

interpretation_rules.empirical_ordering: The empirical winner is the observed minimum of the prespecified macro endpoint; ordering alone is not a significance claim.
interpretation_rules.first_tier: Membership means that inferiority to the empirical endpoint winner was not established under the predeclared block test. It does not establish equivalence, equal performance, or superiority.
interpretation_rules.matched: These component effects are conditional on each task's locked TL-QLDMR configuration, preprocessing, landmarks, and feature map. The removal variants were not independently retuned, and failure to reject does not establish equal performance.
interpretation_rules.adverse_results: Every Holm-significant favorable and adverse direction is retained.

solver_accounting.accounting_sentence: The audited Q1 search issued 3,888 distinct within-task--method configuration queries (54 per pair) and 10,368 fit records; 3,455 queried candidates were eligible under the frozen selection rule. Among 9,720 kernel seed fits, 1,214 still missed the fixed-feature primal--dual-gap certificate after the predeclared retry and therefore made their candidate ineligible; 8,506 kernel seed fits met the certificate. Across kernel and HistGBR fits, the records contain 12,691 solver attempts and 32,207,875 reported iterations. Summed per-fit recorded time was 50.70 h. This sum is descriptive because tasks ran in parallel; it is neither elapsed wall-clock time nor inference latency. The certificate applies only to the chosen fixed-feature objective and does not certify Nyström approximation error or predictive generalization.
